scope: One-minute unchanged interactive small-game workload on one Windows laptop; camera-report CPU optimization, not AAA performance or scanout FPS.
change: Read current camera/lens/lighting for report projection without extracting geometry, skin palettes or UI. Keep owner report boundaries, rendering and host wait policy.
unchanged: World, native gameplay image, graphics settings, renderer and shaders; JSON request/response contract and gameplay services ABI.

machine.cache_state: Existing engine shader/package caches; fresh native process and cold scene upload. No cache reset.

summary.eligible_interval_exclusions: Both returns and intervening rows focused, with contiguous recorded sequences; neither endpoint nor intervening row paused, replay, resize, capture, storage, skip, error or replacement. Raw rows and all intervals remain available; this filter is not a performance qualification.
summary.timing: Steady CPU nanoseconds relative to capture epoch; poll/stages are wall durations and overlap. GPU values are independent queue durations. Present-return cadence includes host gaps; it is not scanout or input latency.

budgets.explanation: Application present-return cadence, not scanout FPS. No frame generation.

owner_closure.scope: Exact recorded benchmark endpoints only; unrelated native windows are preserved.

setup_attempts.reason: Windows regression supervisor referenced a nonexistent client module path; corrected to the package files before a fresh run.

limits: Sequential reference/candidate runs; no randomized repeat, thermal control, other machines or production workload qualification. GPU durations also vary despite unchanged renderer; the entire cadence difference is not isolated to the CPU query.
CPU wall stages overlap. Host gap includes reconciliation, IPC, waiting and scheduling; it is not a dedicated camera-query timer.
Projection queries validate cameras and lighting independently of unrelated mesh/skin extraction. Full snapshots now check rigid camera transforms before geometry extraction.
VRAM, physical input, input latency and the thirty-minute reliability gate are not qualified by these checks.
